readme: Declares task execution and asynchronous networking. Runtime-selected concurrency without function coloring --- The backend is epoll on Linux, kqueue on Darwin/BSD, and IOCP on Windows. ---
Import this module with use task.

files.content:
-- Declares task execution and asynchronous networking.
--- Runtime-selected concurrency without function coloring ---
--- The backend is epoll on Linux, kqueue on Darwin/BSD, and IOCP on Windows. ---

public define Executor as opaque.
public define Channel as opaque.
public define Scope as opaque.
public define Pool as opaque.
public define Net as opaque.
public define Socket as opaque.

public use "task" function backend() of type integer 8.
public use "task" function which() of type pointer to byte.
public use "task" function executor() of type fallible pointer to Executor.
public use "task" function block(callback of type function() of type nothing for c) of type nothing.

public use "task" function channel() of type fallible pointer to Channel.
public use "task" function send(channel of type pointer to Channel, value of type integer 64) of type boolean.
public use "task" function receive(channel of type pointer to Channel, output of type pointer to integer 64) of type boolean.

public use "task" function scope() of type fallible pointer to Scope.
public use "task" function launch(scope of type pointer to Scope, callback of type function(integer 64) of type nothing for c, argument of type integer 64) of type boolean.
public use "task" function join(scope of type pointer to Scope) of type nothing.

public use "task" function pool() of type fallible pointer to Pool.
public use "task" function submit(pool of type pointer to Pool, callback of type function(integer 64) of type nothing for c, argument of type integer 64) of type boolean.
public use "task" function wait(pool of type pointer to Pool) of type nothing.

public use "task" function affinity(cpu of type integer 64) of type boolean.
public use "task" function label(name text) giving boolean.

public use "task" function net(executor of type pointer to Executor) of type pointer to Net.
public use "task" function kind(net of type pointer to Net) of type integer 8.
public use "task" function listen(net of type pointer to Net, port of type integer 32) of type pointer to Socket.
public use "task" function connect(net of type pointer to Net, host of type pointer to byte, port of type integer 32) of type pointer to Socket.
public use "task" function pull(socket of type pointer to Socket, buffer of type pointer to byte, size of type integer 64) of type integer 64.
public use "task" function push(socket of type pointer to Socket, buffer of type pointer to byte, size of type integer 64) of type boolean.
